PIGMNT.title: Ginseng EP
PIGMNT.label: CDR
PIGMNT.about:
The second year of Create Define Release’s Pathways programme kicks off with a five-track EP by North-West London artist PIGMNT, backed with a Roska remix.
London born and bred, PIGMNT’s music combines a distinctive inner-city grit with a rhythmic energy that draws from key dance music styles from the African diaspora – particularly UK Funky, Amapiano, Gqom and Tribal. Releasing music consistently for half a decade now, he’s previously released on labels like Sweet Shop, Club Djembe and Funky Adjacent, and been supported by DJs and taste-makers including Ikonika, Scratchclart, Pearson Sound, Emily Dust and Bok Bok.
Like many Londoners, PIGMNT’s earliest productions were heavily inspired by grime and dubstep (like many grime fans, he first started making beats on Playstation game Music 2000 - heritage!), but as he’s opened up his sound palette, he’s let in influences as varied as Kaytranda, Hyperdub, Night Slugs and Flying Lotus, while always keeping his eyes firmly on what matters most when making dance music: keeping things properly danceable.
PIGMNT’s EP for Pathways centres around four plants – Nettle Root, Ginseng, Suma Root and Ashwagandha – and the properties of each. In PIGMNT’s words: ‘each track is linked to a holistic herb. It’s an idea I’ve wanted to explore for a while, especially after discovering Metal Fingers, aka MF DOOM’s Special Herbs series years ago, but I’d never fully followed through with it until now. I’ve always believed that music itself can be healing, so this felt like a natural way to take that idea further by directly tying the tracks to herbs with known properties.’
‘I liked the idea of tying these meanings into the music itself by making the tracks quite sub-heavy and bass-driven, creating a physical, visceral experience where you’re not just hearing the music, you’re feeling it in your body. In a way, that connects back to the idea of healing. Overall, it’s about combining sound, feeling and idea, letting people engage with it on whatever level they choose, whether that’s purely musical or something a bit deeper.’
A genre-bending, groove-led EP that’s as physical as it is conceptual, ‘Ginseng’ showcases PIGMNT’s music at its most deep and powerful.
PIGMNT.credits:

Written and produced by PIGMNT
Remix of 'Nettle Root' by Roska

PIGMNT.title: Green Ranger EP
PIGMNT.about: The Green Ranger EP marks the 12th release via Native Moves from the North West London DJ and Producer PIGMNT. The EP explores and skillfully unifies elements found in Afro Club scenes across the globe. Tracks like ‘Lucky Star’ & ‘Green Ranger’ capture the soul, celestial textures and resonant thumping low end of Amapiano. Whilst the production on ‘Ancient Technology,’ & ‘Warrior Spirit’ pull inspiration from the magnetic rhythms of UK Funky, Gqom and unfiltered Afro Tech.

PIGMNT.title: Solar Flare
PIGMNT.about:
📡 BREAKING: Dancefloors Disrupted Worldwide — Cause Confirmed as SOLAR FLARE
LONDON, UK — In the early hours, an intense solar flare erupted, unleashing a wave of electromagnetic energy so powerful it’s thrown global nightlife into chaos.
Authorities have traced the surge back to a sonic anomaly: the Solar Flare release by London’s own PIGMNT.
Basslines charged like plasma, grooves warped by radiation—these tracks are frying systems and lighting up dancefloors. Triggering spontaneous movement, hardware meltdowns, and euphoric outbreaks from Hackney to Tokyo.
Expect bass quakes, flare-ups of euphoria, and solar-charged breakdowns that’ll leave you scorched.

PIGMNT.about: Amanesia is a captivating fusion of Funky vibes with a unique blend of UK and South African influences. The thumping, groovy log drum adds depth and richness to the track, making it a must-listen for anyone craving something fresh and exciting in the music scene.

PIGMNT.title: Blue Lotus
PIGMNT.about: "Blue Lotus" blends the enchanting elements of Amapiano with deep, funky, and spiritual undertones, creating a track that oscillates between genre boundaries. The song, delivered with a touch of "FunkyAma" flair, takes listeners on a journey. The opening chords set a meditative tone, which is later propelled forward with a deep, bumping log drum and tribal percussion. The infusion of these rhythmic elements, coupled with smooth melodies, crafts an immersive experience that feels both ancient and contemporary. "Blue Lotus" encapsulates an ethereal essence, guiding the audience through an otherworldly experience, stirring the soul long after a single listening session.
PIGMNT.credits:
released December 20, 2023
Production by Pigmnt
Written by Pigmnt
Mixed & Mastered by Don J Clive
Artwork by Pigmnt

PIGMNT.title: Get Low
PIGMNT.about:
This track is a concoction of cultural influences, featuring powerful percussion, crisp synth leads, warm soulful chords, and a weighty log drum that drives a groovy and familiar rhythm, seamlessly blending the essence of London with South Africa. The track exudes a captivating freshness while delving deep into the realms of UK Funky Afrohouse, Gqom, and Amapiano.
This track is a celebration of rhythm and soul, a testament to the power of music to unite and uplift.
Enjoy!

PIGMNT.title: Jumbo
PIGMNT.about: PIGMNT's "Jumbo" is a sonic powerhouse that boasts a vibrant energy accompanied by its funky swing. Backed up by the hard, militant drums, Jumbo's deep, thumping low end creates an intense, driving force yet, evokes a nostalgic "Streets Of Rage" type feel, brought on by the retro, arcade-inspired leads. Despite its tough edge, the track is undeniably groovy, blending elements of Gqom and Tribal rhythms with its playful yet assertive Funk. A track designed to wake up the party, hitting with both precision and swagger, keeping the dance floor locked in with its rhythmic tones.
PIGMNT.credits:
released September 1, 2024
Production by Pigmnt
Written by Pigmnt
Mixed & Mastered by Don J Clive
Artwork by Pigmnt
